title: Generic communication survey experiment lifecycle
controller_rule: Only the controller may accept this plan into project state

windows.title: Research question, theory, and contribution
responsibilities: Turn the topic into answerable questions, mechanisms, rival explanations, and contribution claims.

windows.title: Literature search and evidence map
responsibilities: Establish the verified evidence base, disagreements, boundary conditions, and unresolved gaps.

windows.title: Constructs and measurement
responsibilities: Map every theoretical construct to observations and assess validity, reliability, and proxy limits.

windows.title: Design, sampling, and ethics
responsibilities: Specify population, sample, timing, comparison, ethics, privacy, estimand, and analysis boundaries.

windows.title: Randomization and protocol
responsibilities: Lock randomization, allocation, manipulation checks, outcomes, exclusions, power, and attrition handling.

windows.title: Data provenance and quality audit
responsibilities: Verify sources, units, keys, joins, missingness, exclusions, versions, and row transitions.

windows.title: Exploratory data analysis
responsibilities: Describe data quality and patterns without converting exploration into confirmatory evidence.

windows.title: Confirmatory estimation
responsibilities: Estimate the locked estimand using the prespecified primary specification and diagnostics.

windows.title: Robustness and sensitivity
responsibilities: Test plausible alternative specifications and threats without selecting results by significance.

windows.title: Independent result audit
responsibilities: Independently verify sample, estimand, code, diagnostics, tables, and claim strength.

windows.title: Tables, figures, and result narrative
responsibilities: Create a consistent data-to-table-to-figure-to-text result chain.

windows.title: Manuscript integration
responsibilities: Integrate the question, evidence, design, results, limitations, and contribution for the target audience.

windows.title: Final manuscript and citation audit
responsibilities: Verify claim-source support, numerical consistency, reporting requirements, and completion evidence.
